headline: United's hubs run normally; a ground stop is holding flights into LaGuardia.

items.text: United's hubs are running normally: all seven reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better (within 30 minutes of schedule).
The FAA has a ground stop in effect for flights into New York LaGuardia (LGA) until 9:15 PM ET because of an equipment outage. It rates the chance of an extension as low.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to LaGuardia, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
